// Fixture: ozzo-dbx code next to Relica code. The same method names mean
// ozzo-dbx's rules here (it passes a pre-quoted name through), so the
// Relica-specific checks must skip this file.
package legacy

import dbx "github.com/go-ozzo/ozzo-dbx"

func list(db *dbx.DB) {
	db.Select("1").From("t").OrderBy("`id` ASC", "a DESC, b").All(nil)
	db.Delete("t", nil).Execute()
}
